q: Does sea freight to Europe count in a Turkish cement exporter's CBAM figure?
title: Turkish cement: sea freight and CBAM
short: No. CBAM embedded emissions stop at the installation gate: direct and, for cement, indirect emissions of production. Shipping from Marmara ports to the EU is not included, though a buyer asking for a full footprint may want it separately.
audience: Cement and clinker exporters in Turkey and their EU importers

ul: In: calcination, kiln fuel, grinding electricity, and precursors such as clinker bought in.
Out: transport to port, sea freight, unloading in the EU.

p: Construction buyers working on product footprints count transport to site. Keep bills of lading and voyage data if they ask.
Freight invoices may carry an EU ETS shipping surcharge. That is a cost passed through by the carrier, not part of CBAM.
